title: Closing-Account Schedule for Pre-K Tuition Payment Plans
content:
**Schedule.** Under the closing-account schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a payment plan on an enrollment that has moved from Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) to Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible), so that no more tuition posts on it, carries an addition to the down payment. The test is the number of days between the date the move took effect, as recorded on the enrollment, and the day the plan is set up:

| The enrollment | Added to the down payment |
|---|---|
| its move to Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) took effect no more than 30 days before the day the plan is set up | 25.00 |
| its move took effect more than 30 days before that day | 15.00 |
| any other enrollment, including one still on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | nothing |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical plan set up on 31 March)

| Move took effect | Days before the plan | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March | 0 | 25.00 |
| 1 March | 30 | 25.00 |
| 28 February | 31 | 15.00 |
| no move | not applicable | nothing |
